name: Page Ruler
summary: Drags a labeled pixel ruler rectangle over the page that continuously reports width, height, start and end coordinates for measuring elements and spacing.
browsersNote: Edge listing carries the same description text; AMO has a same-name 'Page Ruler' by another author, publisher match unconfirmed.
license: Proprietary; no open-source license stated on the store page.
goodFor: Measuring widths, heights and coordinates with a draggable pixel ruler.
install: Open the store page in your browser.
Choose Add to Chrome (or Add to browser) and confirm the permissions the store page lists.
Find the extension in the extensions menu (chrome://extensions in Chrome) and pin it if you want it in the toolbar.
keywords: ruler measure pixels spacing coordinates dimensions
